answer_1.quote: We design a pipeline, ParallelPARC (Parallel Paragraph Creator) to scale up the process of generating analogies between paragraphs ... leveraging recent progress in LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: paragraph-level analogies and distractor paragraphs describing scientific processes

answer_3.quote: We input randomly selected annotated candidates (30 examples ...) into GPT ... Following the in-context learning phase, we run the model on our unlabeled analogy candidates.

answer_4.quote: We hired Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) workers ... The task is to determine whether the paragraphs are analogous and the similar relations are correct.
answer_4.guideline: Workers decide if the two paragraphs describe analogous processes and label issues such as dissimilar relations, misinformation, cyclic vs. non‑cyclic, or other.
criteria: issue categories (dissimilar relations, misinformation, cyclic/non‑cyclic, other)
